### Added

- (agent-platform) [Fill in a new workspace's technical name from its name](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3503) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On New workspace, `Name` takes any name, such as `My Workspace`, and the field below says the technical name filled in from it. A technical name of your own goes under `Advanced options`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Say the portal session ended when the portal refuses the session token](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3507) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — When the portal no longer accepts your session, e.g. after a rollout, the credential form, Connect a model, Edit model and a model's page say `Your portal session ended` and offer `Sign in again`, instead of `Failed user token verification`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.38.9...v3.39.0
